lede: The most-read thing on the web today comes with no story attached. Wikipedia's top article, Christa Pike, drew 1,708,406 views, 3.1 times the day's runner-up, and no other feed carried a headline, search or post to explain the surge. The rest of the snapshot was quieter: Kid Rock's new single led YouTube at 685,788 views while his name also surfaced on Bluesky, and a China Open match between Alex de Minaur and Quentin Halys appeared on both Google Trends and Polymarket.
